faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Our Support
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before partnering with WEZO MEDIA.
faq.q1: What does an integrated digital marketing agency like WEZO MEDIA actually do?
faq.a1: Unlike single-tactic freelancers, WEZO MEDIA manages the complete value chain: understanding your market, crafting the strategy, producing creative content and videos, setting up and scaling paid ad campaigns, engineering high-converting landing pages, and providing continuous data analytics. You gain an accountable partner who coordinates all required specializations seamlessly.
faq.q2: How much does digital marketing support cost in Morocco?
faq.a2: Cost is directly tied to the scope of your business and the active pillars required (strategic depth, content volume, ad campaign management, web infrastructure). We do not offer cheap, throwaway packages: each engagement is custom-scoped following your project review to ensure an investment return that makes economic sense for your margins.
faq.q3: What advertising budget should we plan for paid campaigns?
faq.a3: Ad spend depends on your industry, competition density, and commercial targets. To test audiences properly and gather statistically valid conversion data in Morocco, we generally recommend an initial media spend of at least 3,000 to 5,000 MAD per month, scaling upward as profitability is systematically proven.
faq.q4: Can WEZO MEDIA handle both creative content and advertising campaigns?
faq.a4: Yes, that is the foundational premise of our integrated model. Over 70% of campaign performance hinges on creative relevance, messaging, and visual resonance. When the content creators and media buyers work within the same room, we eliminate friction and can iterate creatives rapidly based on live performance data.
faq.q5: Do you work with SMEs and local businesses?
faq.a5: Absolutely. A substantial portion of our clients are Moroccan SMEs, growing retail brands, clinics, and professional service companies looking to formalize and scale their customer acquisition without the prohibitive overhead of hiring a full in-house marketing department.
faq.q6: How does onboarding work with WEZO MEDIA?
faq.a6: The engagement begins with your online project review submission, followed by a strategic discovery call to diagnose your current bottlenecks. We then deliver a tailored roadmap highlighting high-priority intervention pillars. Once approved, our team moves directly into asset production and campaign infrastructure setup.
faq.q7: Does every client receive the same strategy or standardized template?
faq.a7: No, never. An e-commerce decor brand, a B2B corporate consultancy, and a private education facility have fundamentally different customer buying cycles and margin profiles. Every roadmap is built around your validated strengths, specific market bottlenecks, and financial goals.
